svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Cut the drum 320 above its own floor; the drum floor is the tub

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: floor. File the rim smooth and level.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor: 76 mm centre hole for the standpipe grommet; four 9 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes 62.5 each side of centre along the machine and 150 each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side across it, onto the two tub members.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back wall: 98 mm hole, centre 64 above the floor, on the line

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through the tub centre toward the back, for the tailings pipe.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lid clamps: drill their bases 45 degrees each side of the front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: standpipe (63 mm pipe, 50 long) through its grommet, sitting

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the upper bearing plate; tailings pipe through its grommet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: fill 50 mm deep with water; no leaks at either grommet.
